Nomad is an incredibly proud warrior. He doesn't think twice at killing others or even harvesting the souls of innocents. Probably best to not mention that he's somewhat bald.

Quest: Nomad's Requiem

Combat: As the final boss in a high-level quest he offers a horrific battle involving duplicates of himself, proximity mines, and a devastating attack from which you'd better try to hide. Plus, he replenishes his own health. He also has an attack where he teleports you into the centre of the arena, freezes you and proceeds to take away all your life points except 1.
